why: Each box is cut by an X into 4 small triangles. The number of black triangles goes up by one: 1, 2, 3, so the missing box has all 4 triangles black, still cut by an X. Option 4 fits. Options 1 and 2 are black too but are cut by only one line (2 triangles), and option 3 has only 2 black triangles.
trick: Count the black parts box by box; look closely at faint lines inside dark options.
note: Options 1, 2 and 4 are all fully black; they differ only by faint dividing lines in the scan.
